title: Domain Classification-based Source-specific Term Penalization for Domain Adaptation in Hate-speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating cross-domain hate speech detection performance (Macro-F1) on out-of-domain datasets to measure the model's reliance on dataset-specific source features.
Extracting and penalizing topic-specific terms (e.g., terms related to sports or commentary) and observing the impact on feature attribution scores and generalizability.

Qualitative and quantitative analysis of false positives and false negatives, alongside feature attribution scores, for text instances containing specific identity terms and domain-specific vocabulary.
